profile_text.body:
Magic School, Inc. operates MagicSchool, which its website describes as an AI platform built for school districts. The site says the platform is intended to help districts deliver what it calls safer, smarter, and more personalized education at scale, and it lists tools including a lesson plan generator, rubric generator, presentation generator, multiple choice quiz maker, and worksheet generator. The site also highlights protecting privacy and security, driving student outcomes, building AI literacy, saving time, integrating quickly, and writing AI policy.

According to the product record, MagicSchool covers lesson planning, feedback, IEP drafting, and student chat tools. Teachers are the primary users, and students use it only through a school implementation; educator accounts are for ages 18 and up. A Student Data Privacy Addendum is incorporated for student-facing services, and separate district agreements are accepted. Pricing includes a free tier, Plus at $12.99 per month or $99.96 per year, and Enterprise by quote.
